dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, thanks for inviting me to the family dinner at your aunt's house on Sunday. I'm a bit nervous!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈθæŋks fər ɪnˈvaɪtɪŋ miː tə ðə ˈfæməli ˈdɪnər ət jʊr ˈænts ˈhaʊs ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ. aɪm ə ˈbɪt ˈnɜːrvəs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. My aunt and uncle are really friendly.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. maɪ ˈænt ənd ˈʌŋkəl ər ˈriːli ˈfrɛndli.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But I don't know much about Thai customs. What am I supposed to do when I arrive?
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ˈmʌtʃ əˈbaʊt ˈtaɪ ˈkʌstəmz. ˈwʌt æm aɪ səˈpoʊst tə ˈduː wɛn aɪ əˈraɪv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: First, you're supposed to take off your shoes before you go into the house.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, jʊr səˈpoʊst tə ˈteɪk ˈɔːf jʊr ˈʃuːz bɪˈfɔːr juː ˈɡoʊ ɪntə ðə ˈhaʊs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So I'll be barefoot all evening?
dialogue.reading: soʊ aɪl bi ˈbɛrfʊt ˈɔːl ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. At my aunt's house, everyone walks barefoot.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ət maɪ ˈænts ˈhaʊs, ˈɛvriwʌn ˈwɔːks ˈbɛrfʊt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And how do I greet your family? Do I say hello in Thai?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈɡriːt jʊr ˈfæməli? duː aɪ ˈseɪ həˈloʊ ɪn ˈtaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, and you're supposed to wai the older people. Put your hands together and bow your head a little.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənd jʊr səˈpoʊst tə ˈwaɪ ði ˈoʊldər ˈpiːpəl. ˈpʊt jʊr ˈhændz təˈɡɛðər ənd ˈbaʊ jʊr ˈhɛd ə ˈlɪtəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is there anything I'm not supposed to do?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪm ˈnɑːt səˈpoʊst tə ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Just one thing: you're not supposed to start eating before the older people do.
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒʌst ˈwʌn ˈθɪŋ: jʊr ˈnɑːt səˈpoʊst tə ˈstɑːrt ˈiːtɪŋ bɪˈfɔːr ði ˈoʊldər ˈpiːpəl ˈduː.
